FLASHCARD SET · AGES 4–5

Plants & How They Grow — the parent shelf: 41 cards to download and print.

The whole plant deck for printing at home: forty-one plants-and-how-they-grow cards for ages four to five, each with its try-it job, its four pills — age, subject, level, skill — its download button and one-tap printing; the library is the parents’ side of the class, so everything happens on this one shelf.

This is the parents’ copy of Class 48 · Plants & How They Grow: all forty-one plant flashcards on one shelf, ready to print. Pick the plant idea your week needs most, download the card and print it full size on A4 or Letter paper — every card carries one try-it job underneath and four pills on top: the age it suits, the subject it teaches, the grade level to start at and the skill it builds. The download button takes the full-resolution JPG; the print button runs a single card through your printer with nothing else on the page. There are no card pages to hop through: the shelf is the whole set.

The shelf is yours; the lesson is the child’s. The class page at Plants & How They Grow teaches each idea the way a teacher would — spoken to your child, the plant word named plainly, one small thing to try today — while this wall simply holds the deck for printing. Same forty-one cards, two jobs: the lesson lives in the class, the library is where parents print.

THE THREE LEVELS

Preschool, Grade 1, Grade 2.

Every card wears a level pill so tonight’s card takes one glance to choose. The levels are a suggested order, not a test — the plant job your week needs most is always the right card.

  1. 01

    Preschool · Name it

    the fourteen naming cards — what plants need, the plant’s parts, the plant homes — the words a four-year-old points at and owns.

  2. 02

    Grade 1 · Do it

    the fourteen doing cards — jar gardens, celery races, bark rubbings, bud watches — each one with a job small hands finish in a day.

  3. 03

    Grade 2 · Own it

    the thirteen bigger cards — how plants cook with light, the four ways to make a new plant, the desert’s survival kit — the ideas that grow with the child.

THE GROWING SHELF · 6 CARDS

The growing shelf — from seed crack to young plant.

Seed-growth flashcards for preschool: a seed cracks, the root dives, the shoot climbs, the sprout stretches and the young plant stands — the plants-and-how-they-grow cards that walk a child down the whole road from packet to plant, in order, one stage a card. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE PLANT PARTS SHELF · 7 CARDS

The plant parts shelf — root jobs, stem jobs, leaf magic.

Plant-anatomy flashcards for kids: the trunk, the root jobs, the stem jobs, inside a leaf, leaf shapes, inside a seed and the flower’s own parts — the cards that turn one everyday plant into a machine a four-year-old can name piece by piece. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE PLANT CARE SHELF · 7 CARDS

The plant care shelf — the gardener’s checklist.

Plant-care flashcards for ages 4–5: what plants need, the water path, how plants cook with light, soil sorts, bulbs and tubers, the seasons and the long winter nap — the cards that hand a child the gardener’s checklist in words they own. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE FLOWERS & SEEDS SHELF · 7 CARDS

The flowers & seeds shelf — the bee’s errand, the next generation.

Flower-and-seed flashcards for kids: the bud that blooms, the bee’s pollination errand, the seed factory, the reason fruit exists, the seed-travel wind riders, the slow spread and the four ways plants make more plants — the cards where the garden’s next generation gets made. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE WILD PLACES SHELF · 8 CARDS

The wild places shelf — desert, pond, rainforest.

Habitat flashcards for young naturalists: the four plant homes, the desert’s stored drinks, the pond’s floating city, the rainforest tower, the soft old mosses and ferns, the cactus’s survival kit, the plants that snack on bugs and the trees that keep time — the wild side of the deck. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE PLANT DEFENSE SHELF · 6 CARDS

The plant defense shelf — armor, tricks and helpers.

Plant-defense flashcards for kids: the armor a plant wears, the tricks it plays, the clues it leaves behind, the neighbors it lives with, the grip of a growing vine and the garden’s helper crew — the cards where plants stop being scenery and start being survivors. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.
